body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> DELL(www.dell.com) introduced 'Inspiron Duo' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
'Inspiron Duo' is laptop that 10-inch display Tablet was combined with Intel Atom Processor N550, 2GB Ram and 320GB hard disk.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
